description: This file defines a parser for HTTP path templates used in gRPC Gateway, including tokenization, parsing, and error handling logic.

classes.name: InvalidTemplateError
classes.description: Error type indicating an invalid path template.

classes.name: parser
classes.description: Parser struct for tokenized path templates, with methods for parsing segments and variables.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string path template into a Compiler object, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: topLevelSegments
methods.description: Parses top-level segments of the template.

methods.name: segments
methods.description: Parses multiple segments in the template.

methods.name: segment
methods.description: Parses a single segment, which can be a wildcard, literal, or variable.

methods.name: variable
methods.description: Parses a variable segment enclosed in braces.

methods.name: fieldPath
methods.description: Parses a dot-separated field path within a variable.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Attempts to accept a specific token type from the token stream.

methods.name: expectPChars
methods.description: Validates that a string contains only valid path characters per RFC3986.

methods.name: expectIdent
methods.description: Validates that a string is a valid identifier for protobuf schema.

methods.name: isHexDigit
methods.description: Checks if a rune is a hexadecimal digit.
